panels.description: How to read and operate the Path Forecast Ribbon dashboard

options.content:
## What this shows

- Ribbon: q10/q50/q90 forecast for ${index} at ${horizon}m.
- TP: Live target price (straddle) overlay.
- Coverage: Realized share inside [q10,q90] over Diagnostics window.
- Advisor: Summarizes health, samples, and gap to target.

## Key toggles

- Index: Market to visualize.
- Expiry tag: Select live_csv source (auto/this_week/next_week/this_month/next_month).
- Horizon (min): 30/60/390; affects ribbon and stats.
- Forecaster mode: auto | hybrid | retrieval.
- Window (min): Lookback window for retrieval/features.
- Neighbors (k): Retrieval blend size (higher = smoother).
- Bucket (ms): Time bucket (1m=60000, 5m=300000).
- Time align: trailing (history) | future (project ahead) | auto.
- Calibrate: Apply band_scale so coverage â target.
- Date / now_override_ms: Replay specific day/time (ISO date, epoch ms).
- Diagnostics window: Coverage/stat window length.
- History (min): Visual history for snapshot series.
- Calibrate target: Desired coverage (default 0.8).
- Gap warn/crit: |actual-target| thresholds (0.05/0.10).
- Min samples warn/crit: Data sufficiency thresholds (30/10).

## Tips

- For future view, set Time align=future and use "Zoom next ${horizon}m".
- Compare Calibrated vs Raw panels to assess calibration impact.
- Larger Window and k stabilize bands but can reduce reactivity.
- Date + now_override_ms keep Ribbon/Meta/Stats aligned for replay.

## Useful endpoints

- Health: ${base_url}/health
- Routes: ${base_url}/api/routes
- OpenAPI: ${base_url}/openapi.json
- Docs UI: ${base_url}/docs
